description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Marketing' model class within the OpenCart admin module. The class provides methods to retrieve marketing campaign data and count total marketing records from the database, utilizing SQL queries with filters for date ranges and order statuses.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Represents a model class for retrieving marketing campaign data in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Fetches marketing campaign data with optional filters for order status and date range, including counts of orders and total sales.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total number of marketing records in the database.
